ValidationRule.description: Restrict the user from changing the status of closed case for Pin & Selfie Recovery Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PIN_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Selfie_Recovery' ), IsClosed )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status of a closed case.
